EDA for Title boundary dataset.

What does the data in the Title boundary dataset, look like ?

These are the columns, according to https://digital-land.github.io/specification/dataset/title-boundary/

Field Name Datatype Cardinality
entity Entity integer 1
geometry Geometry multipolygon 1
name Name string 1
notes Notes text 1
organisation Organisation curie 1
point Point point 1
prefix CURIE prefix string 1
reference Reference string 1
entry-date Entry date datetime 1
start-date Start date datetime 1
end-date End date datetime 1

What is entity ?
Geometry looks like polygon for a parcel.
What could be the size of this dataset ?

Looking at a record on the website¶

enitiy seems to be an integer , eg 14725643.
All other attributes give more information about this entity.
Geometry seems to be of type MULTIPOLYGON
Point looks like a lat and long value.
Data for this entity is available as a JSON or GeoJson. No mention of who owns this parcel.
In Quality column it says - Authoritative: We have some data from the authoritative source. What does it mean?

Checking some data in this table.¶

Aha! Found data for swindon. What is the table the query is getting this data from ?`
What is entity ?
Looks like entity is a row in the table

What is reference ? Seems like there is a range for reference sometimes, E60000299;E60000297

A quick google search for E48000038, says "E48000038 is the official Office for National Statistics (ONS) statistical geography code for the Wiltshire & Swindon Local Resilience Forum boundary in England" Seems like entity is just an ID for a row.

More googling -

E48000038 is the official UK statistical geography code designating the Wiltshire & Swindon Local Resilience Forum boundary

E60000297 is the unique ONS (Office for National Statistics) geographic area code for the Swindon Local Planning Authority (LPA) in England.

E63011979 is the official UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) Geographical Code used to identify the Swindon Built-up Area (BUA)

E60000297 is the official UK government statistical identifier code for the Swindon Local Planning Authority (LPA)

E06000030 is the official Government Statistical Service (GSS) code for the Borough of Swindon (Swindon Borough Council), a unitary authority in the South West region of England

So 'entity' remains for same for another area within swindon. What about reference ?

Quering by reference give the same data, seems like this is for all of swindon ? Time to take a look at local-authority-district dataset on the website.
